live.why: The entry path is a regular file inside the scored root.
The row has eleven cells; a pipe inside a cell adds a field, so the literal-pipe and escaped-pipe cases are both covered by the field count.
The row's used-by token set is exactly the admitted entries citing the id.
The row's recheck cell is an ISO date, an NNd cadence or a symbolic cadence.
The row's anchor cell carries the sha256 of the named receipt.
The entry's gate-quote for the id is a contiguous substring of the receipt bytes.
The entry's gate-quote for the id is 1-25 words long.
The O_NOFOLLOW flag on the final open() call.

not-load-bearing.reason: TOCTOU-only defence in depth. The S_ISLNK component walk already rejects every static symlinked tree, and no static tree can kill the open-time flag, so this clause is never counted as load-bearing. The r34 closure routed it as TOCTOU-only; the r35 split names the S_ISLNK walk as load-bearing (controls/c1-entry-symlink kills it) and this open-time flag as the non-load-bearing half.

retired.why: In PRED-C1-r34-v1 the word bound was checked against `found`, which was pinned by `found == quote` to a frozen short quote, so the bound could never fail. It was dead code under its own frozen spec. The r35 counter makes the entry's quote a free variable, so the bound is live and has a failing case (controls/c1-quote-long).

note: A clause is covered when it names a control whose committed receipt records a TARGET_MISSED verdict, or when it carries a not-load-bearing declaration with a reason. Exactly one clause may carry such a declaration.
